definitions.text_en: to have a good smell, scent, be fragrant
definitions.text_mt: Għandu riħa tajba jew pjaċevoli
Ikollu reputazzjoni tajba fost in-nies
Jkun skars, ma jinstabx faċilment

usage_examples.en: The roses made the whole garden fragrant.
His name was renowned in every locality.
Our money became scarce at this time.

definitions.text_mt: Id-dehra jew il-forma esterna ta' xi ħaġa jew persuna

usage_examples.en: This figure is made of wood.
He has a beautiful and strong figure.

definitions.text_en: third-person masculine singular pronominal form of f’: in him (it)
definitions.text_mt: Forma pronominali maskili singular tat-tielet persuna tal-prepożizzjoni 'f': fih

usage_examples.en: The book contains many interesting stories.
There is nothing in it but dust.

definitions.text_en: third-person feminine singular pronominal form of f’: in her (it)
definitions.text_mt: Forma pronominali femminili singular tat-tielet persuna tal-prepożizzjoni 'f': fiha

usage_examples.en: The bag contains all my money.
This city has much beauty in it.

definitions.text_mt: Annimal kbir terrestri b'ġilda ħoxna griża, żunżana twila u snien kbar tal-avorju

usage_examples.mt: Il-fil huwa l-ikbar annimal li jgħix fuq l-art.
usage_examples.en: The elephant is the largest animal living on land.

usage_examples.mt: Fil-bliet Asjatiċi, il-fil kien jintuża għat-trasport.
usage_examples.en: In Asian cities, the elephant was used for transport.

definitions.text_mt: Bla riżultat, għal xejn, inutilment

usage_examples.mt: Kull sforz li għamilt kien fil-batal.
usage_examples.en: Every effort I made was in vain.

usage_examples.mt: Fittixna għalih imma kollox kien fil-batal.
usage_examples.en: We searched for him but everything was in vain.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin ta' wara nżul ix-xemx, fl-għaxija

usage_examples.en: We'll come in the evening after work.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġardinara jaħdmu fil-għaxija meta jkun frisk.
usage_examples.en: The gardeners work in the evening when it is cool.

definitions.text_mt: Iż-żmien tal-ġurnata bejn nżul ix-xemx u l-lejl

usage_examples.en: The evening is a time of rest.
I prefer the evening over the morning.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin tal-bidu tal-jum, wara t-tlugħ ix-xemx

usage_examples.en: I exercise in the morning.
The birds start singing early in the morning.

definitions.text_mt: Minn kull mija, għal kull mija

usage_examples.en: Ten percent of the students passed the exam.
The interest rate is three percent.

definitions.text_mt: Bis-sewwa, verament, tassew

usage_examples.mt: Fil-verità, ma kontx naf b'dan il-fatt.
usage_examples.en: In truth, I did not know about this fact.

usage_examples.mt: Fil-verità, huwa raġel onest u ġeneruż.
usage_examples.en: In truth, he is an honest and generous man.

definitions.text_en: to paralyse, cause to become paralysed
definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-ħila li jiċċaqlaq f'parti minn ġismu

definitions.text_en: to paralyse, cripple, hamstring (prevent from functioning properly)
definitions.text_mt: Iwaqqaf xi ħaġa milli taħdem sew, ifixkel it-tħaddim ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.en: The heart attack paralysed half his body.
The dry summer paralysed agriculture in the region.

definitions.text_mt: Ħwawar li jinkiseb mill-pjanta Piper nigrum, magħmul minn qmuħ żgħar li jintużaw għat-tħawwir tal-ikel

usage_examples.mt: Żid ftit filfel mal-ikel biex jagħtih togħma.
usage_examples.en: Add some pepper to the food to give it flavour.

usage_examples.mt: Il-felfula hija iktar qawwija mill-filfel mitħun.
usage_examples.en: The peppercorn is stronger than ground pepper.

definitions.text_mt: Ħwawar li jinkiseb mill-pjanta Piper nigrum, magħmul minn qmuħ żgħar li jintużaw għat-tħawwir tal-ikel

usage_examples.mt: Il-filfil huwa wieħed mill-eqdem ħwawar magħrufa.
usage_examples.en: Pepper is one of the oldest known spices.
Ground pepper is used in many dishes.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin ta' wara nżul ix-xemx

usage_examples.en: My family gathers together in the evening.
Every day, I go for a walk in the evening.

definitions.text_mt: Iż-żmien tal-ġurnata minn wara nżul ix-xemx sa qabel l-irqad

usage_examples.en: The evening is a beautiful time for relaxation.

usage_examples.mt: Matul il-filgħaxija, it-tfal jagħmlu d-doveri tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: During the evening, the children do their homework.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin tal-bidu tal-jum, minn tlugħ ix-xemx sa nofsinhar

usage_examples.en: In the morning, I drink coffee.
The milk is delivered early in the morning.

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Asja magħmul minn gżejjer
L-isem uffiċjali tiegħu hu Repubblika tal-Filippini

usage_examples.mt: Il-Filippini hu arċipelagu b'ħafna gżejjer sbieħ.
usage_examples.en: The Philippines is an archipelago with many beautiful islands.

usage_examples.mt: Il-Filippini għandhom kultura rikka u diversa.
usage_examples.en: The Philippines has a rich and diverse culture.

definitions.text_en: no sooner, as soon as, barely
definitions.text_mt: Mill-ewwel li, hekk kif, malli

usage_examples.en: No sooner had he arrived than the rain started.
As soon as he opened the door, the alarm went off.

definitions.text_mt: L-istudju tal-mistoqsijiet fundamentali dwar l-eżistenza, l-għarfien, il-valuri, ir-raġuni u l-lingwa

usage_examples.en: Philosophy is a fascinating subject.
He dedicated his life to the study of philosophy.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tistudja l-filosofija jew li tidħol f'diskussjonijiet dwar in-natura tal-eżistenza u l-għarfien

usage_examples.en: Socrates was an influential Greek philosopher.
The philosopher often asks difficult questions.

definitions.text_mt: L-istudju tal-mistoqsijiet fundamentali dwar l-eżistenza, l-għarfien, il-valuri, ir-raġuni u l-lingwa

usage_examples.mt: Il-filosofija Griega hi l-bażi tal-ħsieb tal-Punent.
usage_examples.en: Greek philosophy is the basis of Western thought.
He teaches philosophy at the university.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-filosofija; ibbażat fuq prinċipji filosofiċi

usage_examples.en: The book contains deep philosophical thoughts.

usage_examples.mt: Hija fehma filosofika li tista' tiġi diskussa.
usage_examples.en: It is a philosophical view that can be discussed.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-filosofija; ibbażat fuq prinċipji filosofiċi

usage_examples.mt: Dan l-artiklu hu filosofku wisq għalija.
usage_examples.en: This article is too philosophical for me.
His philosophical language is not easy.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tistudja l-filosofija jew li tidħol f'diskussjonijiet dwar in-natura tal-eżistenza u l-għarfien

usage_examples.en: He is a philosopher known throughout the world.
The philosopher wrote many important books.
